conviction_note: The findings are small and nearly cancel (impact_sum -0.3). The one large positive in the draft, a 47% slide since 30 Sep that the direct peer JD Industrials did not share, was cut to +0.3 because an unexplained drawdown is not evidence of over-reaction and could be informed selling. The scaled number (p_up 54 x abs_move 10 = +0.8) leans slightly up because management guided Q3 GMV growth above Q2's 18.9% and the stock trades at about net cash. The sign gap between the two numbers is small and reflects that lean, not a contradiction.
bar: No sourced Q3 2026 quarterly consensus was found. The bar is derived from the FY2026 revenue consensus of RMB9.9bn (2-3 analysts, range 9.7-10.1bn, S&P Global via https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/zkh/forecast/, page checked 2026-11-13). Less H1 2026 actual revenue of RMB4,557.6m (Q1 2,113.8m https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260521 plus Q2 2,443.8m https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821), that implies H2 +9.3% on H2 2025's RMB4,885.6m, so roughly RMB2.53-2.55bn for Q3 against Q3 2025's RMB2,328.4m. The company's own bar is a guide: Q3 GMV growth above Q2's 18.9%, i.e. GMV above about RMB3.12bn against Q3 2025 GMV of RMB2.62bn. This bar is single-source and possibly stale, so every finding that depends on it is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest (Equibles, FINRA settlements) was 23,529 ADS on 2026-09-30, 10,436 on 2026-10-15 and 13,097 on 2026-10-30. Days to cover was 1.0 each time, against about 150-360k ADS of daily volume, so the stock is not crowded short and there is no squeeze mechanism (https://equibles.com/stocks/zkh/shortinterest). No options market exists (baseline options.status = no_options_market), so there is no skew. FIL Limited/Pandanus reported 10.0% (444.6m shares, about 12.7m ADS) as of 2026-09-30, up from 6.0% at 2025-12-31 (SEC 13G/A filed 2026-11-05). Price path: about $2.90 for most of Aug-Sep, then a slide to a $1.20 low on 2026-11-12, then +15% in the last two sessions to $1.485.

expectations.price_path: Baseline: 5-day run-up +9.63%, 20-day -16.38%, -60.95% from the 52-week high. Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ZKH?range=6mo&interval=1d): $2.81 close on 2026-09-30 to $1.485 on 2026-11-17 (-47%), with a $1.20 low on 2026-11-12 and +15% over 11-16/11-17. Over the same window JD Industrials (7618.HK, the direct listed MRO peer) went from HKD12.63 (week of 2026-09-28) to HKD12.66 on 2026-11-17, about flat (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/7618.HK?range=3mo&interval=1wk). The broad China blue-chip index was about 20% below its June highs by 2026-10-26 (https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/823338). No sector ETF was used.
expectations.vs_targets: Spot $1.485 against a mean target of $4.32, median $4.38 and high $4.85 from 3 analysts, all rated Strong Buy (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/zkh/forecast/, checked 2026-11-13). The investing.com mean is $4.314 (https://www.investing.com/equities/zkh-adr, 2026-11-17). Spot is 66% below the mean. The targets have clearly not been updated through the slide.
expectations.last_print: Q2 2026 (2026-08-21, bmo): revenue RMB2,443.8m (+12.8%) against a reported estimate of about RMB2.37bn, roughly a 3% beat. It was the first operating profit (RMB4.0m), and GMV grew 18.9%. Pre-market headlines said +21% (https://finviz.com/news/384511/zkh-group-shares-surge-21-after-company-reaches-operating-profitability-for-first-time), but the day opened at $2.97 and closed at $2.90, unchanged, on 5.12m ADS against a ~100k median (Yahoo bars). Rebuilt earnings-only reaction history from the confirmed results dates: 2025-08-22 +0.74%, 2025-11-20 +1.65%, 2026-03-19 -28.66% (Q4 gross margin 15.5% vs 17.1%), 2026-05-21 -0.68%, 2026-08-21 0.0% (baseline history rows that match the 6-K results releases).
expectations.short_interest_trend: 13,097 ADS on 2026-10-30 against 10,436 on 2026-10-15, 1.0 days to cover each (https://equibles.com/stocks/zkh/shortinterest). The 11-13 settlement is published 11-24, after the window.
expectations.real_bar: To rise, the stock needs Q3 GMV growth at or above 19% with operating profit held. It also needs no fresh cash-burn shock, plus some sign the company is buying back stock while it trades at about net cash. After a 47% unexplained slide the market's bar is lower than consensus, but if the slide was informed selling, even a clean quarter may not hold.

next_guide.street_full_year: FY2026 revenue RMB9.9bn average (range 9.7-10.1bn, +10.6%), non-GAAP EPS 0.90; FY2027 revenue RMB11.08bn (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/zkh/forecast/, checked 2026-11-13)
next_guide.company_current_guide: FY2026 GMV growth target of 15-20%, Q3 GMV growth expected to exceed Q2's 18.9%, growth expected to accelerate in H2, full-year profitability, international business profitable in H2 (Q2 call 2026-08-21, https://www.mitrade.com/insights/news/live-news/article-0-2022629-20260822; release https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821). No numeric revenue guide.
next_guide.basis: H1 2026 GMV was RMB5.33bn (+16.1%). If Q3 grows about 20%, Q4 needs only about +10% for the low end of the 15-20% target, so the target is nearly secured and a maintain or nudge-up is the likely path. October's official PMI of 49.3 (https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/./202611/t20261103_1965735.html) argues against a bold raise.

findings.finding: On the 2026-08-21 Q2 call management said Q3 GMV growth would exceed Q2's 18.9%, based on July-August order trends, and kept the FY2026 GMV target at 15-20%. That sets a Q3 GMV bar above about RMB3.12bn against RMB2.62bn a year earlier. The stock has since fallen from $2.90 to $1.485, so the market no longer appears to price delivery of that guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The GMV acceleration plus first operating profit at Q2 earned 0.0% close-to-close (2026-08-21) after a pre-market headline of +21%, and the Q1 acceleration earned -0.68% (2026-05-21). This name has not paid for good growth prints.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the company's own public guide, so it is priced in principle. But the ADS has lost 47% since 30 Sep with no company news while the listed peer was flat. If the market believed the guide, the price would be closer to the $2.90 it held through September.
findings.independence: Same guide in the Q2 release ('we expect growth to accelerate further in the second half'), https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821. These are one company source read twice.

findings.finding: The FY2026 revenue consensus of RMB9.9bn (+10.6%, 2-3 analysts) implies H2 revenue growth of only about 9.3% (Q3 about RMB2.53-2.55bn). That is below Q2's actual +12.8% and the guided GMV acceleration. If Q3 revenue grows 13-15% (about RMB2.63-2.68bn), it beats that implied bar by about 3-5%. Q2 also beat (RMB2.44bn vs about 2.37bn est).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 revenue beat of about 3% earned 0.0% (2026-08-21). Q4 2025, where revenue grew 7.9% but gross margin fell to 15.5% from 17.1%, earned -28.66% (2026-03-19). The line that moved this stock is margin, not revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus is thin (2-3 analysts) and likely stale: price targets of $3.74-4.85 sit far above a $1.485 spot, which shows nobody has updated. If the street had re-marked to the Q2 run-rate, the FY range would sit above RMB10bn.
findings.independence: Q2 actual/estimate RMB2.44bn/2.37bn from a search snippet on the investing.com ZKH page (https://www.investing.com/equities/zkh-adr). The Q1 and Q2 revenue figures come from company releases. The bar is single-source, so the size is capped.

findings.finding: ZKH ADS fell 47% from $2.81 (2026-09-30) to $1.485 and touched $1.20 on 2026-11-12, with no 6-K, no company news and no index or governance event found. JD Industrials (7618.HK), the direct listed MRO-procurement peer, was flat over the same weeks (HKD12.63 to 12.66). Market cap is about $234m against June-30 cash plus short-term investments of US$246.5m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior case of a print after a slide like this. The prior print came off a pinned $2.90 range.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is priced by definition. The question is whether the slide is an overshoot (holder liquidation in a thin ADS) or informed selling ahead of a weak Q3. A clean print would show the first; the evidence cannot tell them apart. Sized near zero because an unexplained microcap drawdown is not evidence of over-reaction.
findings.independence: Peer path from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/7618.HK?range=3mo&interval=1wk. Cash from the Q2 release https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821. The broad China market fell about 20% from June highs (https://theedgemalaysia.com/node/823338), which explains only part of the drop.
findings.link: JD Industrials sells the same MRO / production-materials category to the same KA and SOE customer type; no shared-customer figure found

findings.finding: The ADS rallied from $1.29 (2026-11-13 close) to $1.485 (2026-11-17) on rising volume (239.7k and 360.8k ADS vs about 140k earlier in November). That is +15% in two sessions into the print, so part of a relief reaction is already in the price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no comparable pre-print run in the history. The Aug and Nov 2025 prints came off flat tapes.
findings.why_not_priced: It is in the price. The point is that it lowers the payoff of a merely in-line print. Had nobody pre-positioned, the stock would still be at the $1.29 base.
findings.independence: Baseline run_up_5d_pct +9.63% (sealed baseline). Same price series.

findings.finding: China's Q3 industrial backdrop was mixed to weak for MRO demand. The official manufacturing PMI was 49.8 in August and 50.1 in September, then fell to 49.3 in October (below the 50.0 expected). Fixed-asset investment for Jan-Sep 2026 was -7.2% y/y and private FAI -10.4%. This argues against an upside surprise in SME and Q4 demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No company-specific reaction to macro data found.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public macro, so it is largely priced, and its link to ZKH's SME-heavy GMV is not confirmed by the company. Filed small as a proxy.
findings.independence: October PMI 49.3, NBS https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/./202611/t20261103_1965735.html. Proxy only; the company has not confirmed any demand effect.

findings.finding: JD Industrials, ZKH's largest listed direct competitor, reported H1 2026 revenue +27.4% with product sales (MRO plus BOM) +28.2% to RMB12.3bn. Digital industrial procurement demand was strong through June. JD reports half-yearly, so there is no Q3 counterparty read.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an H1 figure published around ZKH's own Q2 print, so it is mostly priced. It is a modest cross-check that the category grows faster than ZKH's 13%, which could equally read as share loss.
findings.independence: Peer's flat share price since September (Yahoo 7618.HK) suggests no sector demand scare.
findings.link: Same product category (MRO and production materials) sold to the same industrial KA and SOE customers. No overlap figure was found.

findings.finding: Only US$7.67m (2.49m ADS) of the US$50m buyback, extended to 2027-06-13, had been used by 2026-06-30. The Q3 release will disclose Q3 repurchases, and the stock now trades at about its June-30 cash plus short-term investments (US$246.5m against about a $234m market cap). An accelerated or upsized buyback is the obvious lever.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback's adoption on 2025-06-13 was followed by a gap down on 2025-06-17 (marketbeat headline). No measured reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 and October repurchase figures are not yet public. If the company had been buying through the October slide, the decline would probably have been less one-way.
findings.independence: Q1 release: 1.48m ADS for US$4.76m by 2026-03-31 (https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260521). That gives a slow pace of about 1m ADS a quarter.

findings.finding: Despite GAAP profit, ZKH used RMB122.4m of operating cash in Q2 2026 (RMB110.7m a year earlier). Cash, restricted cash and short-term investments fell from RMB1.92bn to RMB1.67bn in H1, and active customers fell 1.7% y/y. A further cash draw in Q3 would undercut the profitability story.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not isolated. The Q4 2025 print had positive operating cash flow (RMB116.1m) and still fell 28.66% on gross margin.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public since August, so it is partly priced. Seasonally, cash came in Q4 2025, so Q3 is the quarter where the working-capital draw would show again.
findings.independence: Same figures in the company release https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821. One document.

findings.finding: Director Han Yunjie filed a Form 144 for 285,714 ADSs (about $828.6k) from RSUs vested 2026-08-31, with an approximate sale date of 2026-09-03. A Form 4 shows a sale on 2026-09-11 at about $2.92 per ADS. These are routine vested-RSU sales at the pre-slide price.
findings.why_not_priced: It is small (about 0.2% of ADS-equivalents), public and pre-slide. It matters only if read as insiders selling ahead of a weak quarter, which its RSU origin argues against.

findings.finding: FIL Limited/Pandanus raised its holding from 6.0% (266.8m shares, 2025-12-31) to 10.0% (444.6m shares, about 12.7m ADS, 2026-09-30). The roughly 5.1m-ADS increase is about the size of the 5.12m-ADS volume on the Q2 print day. A large long-only holder was adding at about $2.90; whether it has sold since is unknown, and the slide could be either FIL or another holder (RAYS Capital, for example, dropped to 4.5% by 2025-12-31) exiting.
findings.why_not_priced: Holder data is public but stale at 30 Sep. It identifies a concentrated holder base, where one exit can move a thin ADS 50% without news. The sign is unknown.

findings.finding: Rebuilt from confirmed results dates, ZKH's earnings reactions are +0.74% (2025-08-22), +1.65% (2025-11-20), -28.66% (2026-03-19, gross margin down to 15.5% from 17.1%), -0.68% (2026-05-21) and 0.0% (2026-08-21, first operating profit). The pattern is asymmetric: good growth prints were ignored and the one margin miss cost 29%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the reaction history. Gross margin (Q2 17.6%, +110bp y/y; 3P take rate down 241bp to 11.8%) is the line that moved the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Reaction asymmetry is not a fact about Q3. It lowers the payoff of a beat and fattens the downside tail. The earlier reactions came in a pinned, low-volume regime that may no longer apply at 95% realised vol.
findings.independence: Moves from the sealed baseline's history rows matching the company's own results dates (Q2 release https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821).

findings.finding: H1 2026 GMV was RMB5.33bn (+16.1%; Q1 2,452.8m, Q2 2,877.5m). With Q3 guided above +18.9%, the FY2026 GMV target of 15-20% (RMB11.65-12.16bn on FY2025's 10.13bn) needs only about +10-11% in Q4 for the low end. A maintained or edged-up FY target is the likely next guide, not a cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY target was maintained at Q2 and the stock was flat (0.0%). The FY2026 profitability target set at Q4 2025 coincided with -28.66%, which was driven by margin.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public but nobody published it. A collapsed price with stale $4.3 targets suggests the market is pricing risk to the guide, not its near-certainty. Sized small because it sits inside what the company already guided.
findings.independence: FY2025 GMV RMB10.13bn from the Q4 release https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-unaudited-financial-results-20260319; Q2 GMV from https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/zkh-group-limited-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-20260821. October PMI 49.3 (finding on macro) argues against a raise.

findings.finding: The only company communication after the 2026-08-21 call is a 2026-11-02 PR with Intel launching 'LingLong Insight 1.0', a 4bn-parameter edge AI model for goods-receipt verification. It carries no GMV, customer or financial metrics and no reaffirmation of guidance. The stock spiked to $2.085 intraday and closed +1.2% at $1.66.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-11-02: intraday +27% then +1.2% close (Yahoo bars). The AI story did not hold.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. Filed because the absence of any 'on track' statement during a 50% slide is itself a result: management did not reassure.

outside_window.finding: The FINRA short-interest settlement of 2026-11-13 publishes 2026-11-24, after the exit window. It would show whether shorts built into the November low.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The 20-day run-up of -16% and the -47% slide since September point down, while the 5-day +9.6% bounce points up. My slight positive lean cuts against the longer slide and goes with the bounce, which is why p_up sits at only 54.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the expectations finding on the 47% slide against a flat peer cut from +2.0 to +0.3, kept filed.
Rule 6 (bar unsourced to two agreeing estimates): consensus_bar finding capped from +0.8 to +0.4.

Rule 1 and rule 6 (finding inside what the company guided; this name does not pay for beats): guided-GMV-acceleration finding cut from +1.0 to +0.6; next-guide finding from +0.4 to +0.3; p_up from 57 to 54.

Base-rate lesson (rebuild history from confirmed releases): already done in the draft; abs_move_pct kept at 10 (the realised vol of about 95% annualised and the -28.66% tail outweigh the damped pinned-regime reactions).
Left standing: the macro, peer, capital, cash, insider, holder and reaction-history findings, and the -0.8 pre-print bounce.
